name: Intro: letterbox open
when: The video's first seconds: an animated opening over the first shot itself, the lightest of the intros. Two cinema bars in the ground colours close in (2.39:1), the game's logo lands over the shot, an optional line (the video's subject in a few words) sits in the bottom bar; then the logo lifts away and the bars open the frame to full 16:9.
anchor: Starts at 0 with the video. The logo lands at `at`; the frame opens at `out`: put it on the first strong word of the voice, or on the first beat of the music.
placement: Mount it at the very start (--start 0) over the project's first shot, which plays underneath from 0: pick a calm, readable shot with space in the middle (a skyline, a beach, a drive). Nothing else on screen until the bars have opened.

vars.theme: clean (deep coral bars, white line) or vice (sunset bars, ink line): the video's theme
vars.game: the game, as logos.json names it (Grand Theft Auto VI)
vars.logo: its logo file: filled from assets/logos/ by build_video.mjs when `game` is listed there
vars.title: optional: one short line in the bottom bar, the video's subject in the voice's words (44 characters at most); empty = none
vars.at: seconds after the start: the logo lands (0.3; the bars take the first 0.33 s)
vars.out: seconds after the start: the logo lifts and the bars open (2.6); the scene ends 0.33 s later on the full frame
